Container.Name: Mangarr
Container.Overview: Monitor manga series, download missing chapters, and organize CBZ files for Komga or Kavita.
Container.Description: Mangarr manages a manga library, monitors new chapters, downloads from supported direct sources or an optional qBittorrent client, and writes CBZ files with ComicInfo.xml metadata. Configure a root folder in Mangarr after installation. For torrent imports and hardlinks, mount the same host media directory at the same container path in Mangarr and qBittorrent.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database, API key, and settings.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Shared media folder. Use /media/manga as a root folder and /media/torrents as the downloads folder.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Optional. User id to run as, e.g. 99 (nobody). Leave empty to run as root. Set together with PGID.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Optional. Group id to run as, e.g. 100 (users). Leave empty to run as root. Set together with PUID.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Optional. umask for new files and folders, e.g. 002 for 664/775.

Config.Name: Login disabled (recovery)
Config.Description: Leave false. Set true and restart only if you forgot the Settings → Login password; choose a new one, then set false again.

Config.Name: Manga Library
Config.Description: Bind the image-declared /manga volume to the same manga library folder.
